solution:
Write the numerator as \((9^x - 1) - (5^x - 1)\) and divide numerator and denominator by \(x\), using \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{a^x - 1}{x} = \log a\).
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{9^x - 5^x}{4^x - 1} = \frac{\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{9^x - 1}{x} - \lim_{x \to 0}\frac{5^x - 1}{x}}{\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{4^x - 1}{x}} = \frac{\log 9 - \log 5}{\log 4}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{\log\left(\frac{9}{5}\right)}{\log 4}\)

Group the numerator as \((5^x - 1) + (3^x - 1) - (2^x - 1)\); the added constants cancel with the given \(-1\).
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{5^x + 3^x - 2^x - 1}{x} = \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\frac{5^x - 1}{x} + \frac{3^x - 1}{x} - \frac{2^x - 1}{x}\right] = \log 5 + \log 3 - \log 2\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \log\left(\frac{15}{2}\right)\)

Write the numerator as \((a^x - 1) + (b^x - 1) + (c^x - 1)\) and divide numerator and denominator by \(x\).
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{a^x + b^x + c^x - 3}{\sin x} = \lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\frac{a^x - 1}{x} + \frac{b^x - 1}{x} + \frac{c^x - 1}{x}}{\frac{\sin x}{x}} = \frac{\log a + \log b + \log c}{1}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \log(abc)\)

Since \(3^{x+1} = 3\cdot 3^x\), the numerator is \((6^x - 1) + (5^x - 1) + (4^x - 1) - 3(3^x - 1)\).
Dividing numerator and denominator by \(x\) and using \(\frac{\sin x}{x} \to 1\),
the limit \(= \log 6 + \log 5 + \log 4 - 3\log 3 = \log\left(\frac{6 \times 5 \times 4}{27}\right) = \log\left(\frac{120}{27}\right)\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \log\left(\frac{40}{9}\right)\)

Write the numerator as \(\left(8^{\sin x} - 1\right) - \left(2^{\tan x} - 1\right)\) and divide throughout by \(x\).
\(\frac{8^{\sin x} - 1}{x} = \frac{8^{\sin x} - 1}{\sin x}\cdot\frac{\sin x}{x} \to \log 8 = 3\log 2\), and similarly \(\frac{2^{\tan x} - 1}{x} \to \log 2\).
Also \(\frac{e^{2x} - 1}{x} = 2\cdot\frac{e^{2x} - 1}{2x} \to 2\).
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{3\log 2 - \log 2}{2} = \frac{2\log 2}{2} = \log 2\)

Let \(y = \left(\frac{3 + x}{3 - x}\right)^{\frac{1}{x}}\), so \(\log y = \frac{1}{x}\left[\log\left(1 + \frac{x}{3}\right) - \log\left(1 - \frac{x}{3}\right)\right]\).
Using \(\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{\log(1 + t)}{t} = 1\),
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\log y = \frac{1}{3}(1) + \frac{1}{3}(1) = \frac{2}{3}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= e^{\frac{2}{3}}\)

Let \(y = \left(\frac{3 + 5x}{3 - 2x}\right)^{\frac{2}{x}}\), so \(\log y = \frac{2}{x}\left[\log\left(1 + \frac{5x}{3}\right) - \log\left(1 - \frac{2x}{3}\right)\right]\).
Using \(\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{\log(1 + t)}{t} = 1\),
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\log y = 2\left(\frac{5}{3} + \frac{2}{3}\right) = 2\times\frac{7}{3} = \frac{14}{3}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= e^{\frac{14}{3}}\)

Write \(\log(3 - x) - \log(3 + x) = \log\left(1 - \frac{x}{3}\right) - \log\left(1 + \frac{x}{3}\right)\), since \(\log 3\) cancels.
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{1}{x}\left[\log\left(1 - \frac{x}{3}\right) - \log\left(1 + \frac{x}{3}\right)\right] = -\frac{1}{3}(1) - \frac{1}{3}(1)\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= -\frac{2}{3}\)

Let \(y = \left(\frac{1 + 4x}{1 - 4x}\right)^{\frac{1}{x}}\), so \(\log y = \frac{1}{x}\left[\log(1 + 4x) - \log(1 - 4x)\right]\).
Using \(\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{\log(1 + t)}{t} = 1\),
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\log y = 4 + 4 = 8\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= e^{8}\)

Let \(y = \left(\frac{5 + 7x}{5 - 3x}\right)^{\frac{1}{3x}}\), so \(\log y = \frac{1}{3x}\left[\log\left(1 + \frac{7x}{5}\right) - \log\left(1 - \frac{3x}{5}\right)\right]\).
Using \(\lim_{t \to 0}\frac{\log(1 + t)}{t} = 1\),
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\log y = \frac{1}{3}\left(\frac{7}{5} + \frac{3}{5}\right) = \frac{1}{3}\times 2 = \frac{2}{3}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= e^{\frac{2}{3}}\)

Divide numerator and denominator by \(x\).
Numerator: \(\frac{a^x - 1}{x} - \frac{b^x - 1}{x} \to \log a - \log b\).
Denominator: \(4\cdot\frac{\sin 4x}{4x} - 2\cdot\frac{\sin 2x}{2x} \to 4 - 2 = 2\).
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{\log a - \log b}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\log\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)\)

Divide numerator and denominator by \(x^3\).
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\left(\frac{2^x - 1}{x}\right)^3}{\frac{3^x - 1}{x}\cdot\frac{\sin x}{x}\cdot\frac{\log(1 + x)}{x}} = \frac{(\log 2)^3}{\log 3 \times 1 \times 1}\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{(\log 2)^3}{\log 3}\)

Factorise the numerator: \(15^x - 5^x - 3^x + 1 = 5^x\cdot 3^x - 5^x - 3^x + 1 = \left(5^x - 1\right)\left(3^x - 1\right)\).
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\left(5^x - 1\right)\left(3^x - 1\right)}{x\sin x} = \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\frac{5^x - 1}{x}\cdot\frac{3^x - 1}{x}\cdot\frac{x}{\sin x}\right] = \log 5\cdot\log 3\cdot 1\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \log 3\cdot\log 5\)

Since \((25)^x = \left(5^x\right)^2\), the numerator is \(\left(5^x\right)^2 - 2\left(5^x\right) + 1 = \left(5^x - 1\right)^2\).
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\left(5^x - 1\right)^2}{x\sin x} = \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\left(\frac{5^x - 1}{x}\right)^2\cdot\frac{x}{\sin x}\right] = (\log 5)^2 \times 1\)
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= (\log 5)^2\)

Since \((49)^x = \left(7^x\right)^2\), \((35)^x = 7^x\cdot 5^x\) and \((25)^x = \left(5^x\right)^2\), the numerator is \(\left(7^x - 5^x\right)^2\).
Dividing numerator and denominator by \(x^2\):
\(\frac{7^x - 5^x}{x} = \frac{7^x - 1}{x} - \frac{5^x - 1}{x} \to \log 7 - \log 5 = \log\left(\frac{7}{5}\right)\), and \(\frac{\sin x}{x}\cdot\frac{\log(1 + 2x)}{x} \to 1 \times 2 = 2\).
\(\therefore\) the limit \(= \frac{1}{2}\left[\log\left(\frac{7}{5}\right)\right]^2\)
